nary_nodes.label: Salah signs with Trabzonspor
evidence: Mohamed Salah has signed a two-year deal with Trabzonspor, under which the Egypt forward will receive 17 million euros ($19.6 million) a season, the Turkish club said on Thursday.

The announcement came as Trabzon's fans prepared to head for the club's stadium in the eastern Black Sea city for a ceremony to mark the 34-year-old's former Liverpool player's signing on a free transfer the day after a smiling Salah arrived in Istanbul in the team's burgundy and blue kit.

nary_nodes.label: Trabzonspor statement on Salah's contract
evidence: Mohamed Salah has signed a two-year deal with Trabzonspor, under which the Egypt forward will receive 17 million euros ($19.6 million) a season, the Turkish club said on Thursday.
The club's statement to the Turkish stock exchange said Salah will receive a 20 percent share from products sold under his name, plus conditional bonuses each season.
